Name: Fruit Tree Puddings
Author: Lavliette
Description:
[size=5][i]Fruit Tree Puddings

[/i][/size]They're delicious, they're fruity and it's pudding.
What do you need more?

How does it work?
Just collect three fruits and together with a large milk and some sugar turn them into a delicious pudding in your kitchen.
The pudding is worth 10x the base price and liked by all villagers.
